CHA P. XXV.
Abraham hauing manie childran by his wife Cetura, died at the age 12
Yeares: 12. Iſmaet al ſv hauting twelue ſonnes Dukes, diea. 19. I ſaat praying
for his barren wift, she hath Eſau and Iacob twinnes. 30. Eſau ſelleth his firſt
birth right to Iacob for a m ſe of potage.
N D Abraham maried another wite mamed Cetura:
which bare him Zamran, and Iecſan, and Madan, and
Madian, and Ieſboc, and Sue. 2. Iecſan alfo begat Saba &
A
Dadan. The Children of Dadan were Aſfurim and
Latuiim, and Loomim. 4. But alſo of Madian was borpe
Epha, and Opher , and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa: al theſe were
the children of Cetura. . And Abraham gaue al his poffeſſious to
Ifaac: 6. and to the children of his concubines he gaue guitts, and
ſeparated them from Iſaac his ſonne, whileſt himſelte yet liued, to the
caſt countrie. 7. And the dayes of Abrahams life were an huudred
ſeuentie and fiue veares. 2. And decaying dyed in (2) a good old age,
and hauino liued a great time, and being tul of dayes: and was gathered
to his people. 9. And there buried him Iiaac and Iimacl his ſonnes in
the double cane wluch was ſituated in the field of Ephron the ſoune ot
Seor the Hethite, ouer-againſt Mambre, 10. which he had bought ot
the children of Heth : there was he buried, and Sara his wite. 11. And
atter his death God bleſfed Iſaac his ſonpe, who dwtlled beſide the
wel of the Liuing & Secing, ſo named. 12. Theſe are the generations ot
Iſmael the ſonne of Abraha, whō Agar the Ægyptian bare him, Saraes
ſeruant: & 12. theſe are the names of his children according to their cal-
ling and generations. The firſt begotten of Iſmael Nabaioth, then Ce-
dar, and Adbeel, and Mabſam, 14. Maſma alfo, and Duma, and Maſſa,
15. Hadar, and Themna, and Iethut, and Naphis, and Cedma. 16. Theſe
are the ſonnes of Iſmael: and theſe are their names by their caſtles and
townes, twelue Princes of their tribes. 17. And the veares of Iſmaels
life came to an hundred thirtie ſeauen, and decaying died, and was put
vnto his people. 18. And he dwelt from Heuila euen to Sur, which
looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Aſſitians, before the tace
of al his brethren died he. 19. Theſe alſo are the generations of Iſaac
the ſonne ot Abraham : Abraham begat Iſaac: 20. who when he was
tourtie veares old, tooke to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the
Syrian of Meſopotamia, ſiſter to Laban. 21. And Iſaac beſought our
Lord for his wite, becauſe ſhe was batren: who he ard him, and made
